other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Odisha
Must not already own a pucca house
Must be engaged as a building worker for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months
Must not be employed in construction work covered by the Factories Act, 1948 or the Mines Act, 1952
Must be aged between 18 and less than 60 years
Must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund
Must not be enrolled as a beneficiary in any other district of Odisha or any other state
Must be registered with the Odisha Building & Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board
benefits_summary: Beneficiary receives a pucca house funded up to ₹1.30  lakh (IAP) or ₹1.20  lakh (Non‑IAP) along with wage components and other convergence subsidies.
documents_required: Geo‑tagged photograph of existing kutcha house
Geo‑tagged photograph of proposed construction site
Registration certificate with Odisha Building & Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board
